units.source_text: 梓川峡谷的雾丝毫没有消散的迹象，反而愈来越浓。

en.t: The mist in the Azusa River gorge showed not the slightest sign of clearing; instead, it grew thicker and thicker.

units.source_text: 我在路上走了约莫一个钟头，中间曾经一度想要回到出发地——上高地的温泉旅馆。

en.t: I had been walking along the road for about an hour, and at one point I even thought of returning to my starting point, the hot spring inn at Kamikochi.

units.source_text: 但是即使折返回去，也要等雾散了才行。

en.t: But even if I turned back, I would still have to wait until the mist cleared.
Yet the mist only kept growing thicker.

units.source_text: 算了，干脆接着爬到山顶吧。

en.t: Never mind, I thought; I might as well keep climbing all the way to the summit.
I silently made up my mind.

units.source_text: 因此，为了继续向梓川峡谷前进，得从矮竹林穿过去。

en.t: So, in order to continue on toward the Azusa River gorge, I had to pass through the thicket of low bamboo grass.
